remarks: Be the first to live in this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom apartment! Enjoy a brand-new kitchen featuring white cabinets, quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances. This bright and spacious unit offers an open floor plan and tons of natural light. Apartment includes 3 new, energy efficient wall ac units. Heat, hot water, and cooking gas are all included in the rent-offering unbeatable value.  Walk to Scalzi Park, gyms, Ridgeway Shopping Center, restaurants, and more. Conveniently located on the bus line and just minutes from downtown Stamford. Additional features include a laundry room and extra storage in the basement. One reserved parking space (#48) is included; a second assigned space is available on a month-to-month basis, plus plenty of street parking nearby.  This is a must-see apartment that combines comfort, convenience, and style. Don't miss this opportunity!
